title: hierochloe hirta
intro: Hierochloe hirta, commonly known as sweet grass or Hierochloe, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae and is native to the Northern Hemisphere. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as a digestive aid, calm the nervous system, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hierochloe hirta include its use in traditional medicine as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it effective in treating a variety of conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hierochloe hirta include coumarin, scopoletin, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
